title: Jagged Smoky Turkish Prosciutto Menemen
description: A smoky and savory Turkish dish featuring prosciutto and temper, friendly to ayurvedic tamasic diets, in the form of menemen.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the diced onions.
Cook the onions for 5 minutes or until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the diced bell peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the thinly sliced prosciutto to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes or until crispy.
Add the temper and smoked paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together, then pour them over the top of the skillet.
Scramble the eggs together with the vegetables and prosciutto until they are cooked through.
Stir in the crumbly feta cheese and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with additional feta cheese and prosciutto if desired.
